newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Thursday on thin buying interest, traders said.
"The market is still weak...it does not move at all," said one trader, adding that the weak sentiment was also caused by soft Malaysian values.
Traders said palm olein was unchanged at 1,465-70 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,470-75 rupiah at Wednesday's close, even though offers were also heard at 1,460 rupiah.
There were offers at 1,455 rupiah for purchase above 100 tonnes.
Traders said crude palm oil supply remained tight due to long Eid al-Fitr holidays earlier this month.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Prabu will leave the North Sumatran port on Friday for Bitung with 1,200 tonnes of palm olein. The KM Melati Pratama will leave on Thursday for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta with 1,200 tonnes of palm kernel oil.
The MT Sinar Surya will leave on Friday for Semarang with 2,000 tonnes of palm olein, while the MT Istana V will leave on Friday for Cirebon with 2,000 tonnes of palm olein.
